section_anchor: Where the Jade sits in Gateron's magnetic catalog
brief_summary: Five-row comparison table of Gateron magnetic switches — KS-20 White, Magnetic Jade (KS-20T, coral-highlighted), Jade Pro, Jade Mini E, KS-37B — across initial force, total travel, bottom-out flux, rated lifetime, and bottom style. Left-margin brackets group the first three as the KS-20 (Wooting-side) family and the last two as the KS-37 (Keychron-side) family. Footnote restates that the Pro's tolerance bands are roughly half the base Jade's.
data_sources: apps/web/src/content/articles/gateron-magnetic-jade-deep-dive.mdx:'Where the Jade sits in Gateron's magnetic catalog' — 'The base KS-20 switches — White at 30gf initial, Orange at 38gf — are full-travel parts at 4.1±0.2mm with a flux window of 102±15Gs to 905±80Gs ... open bottom housing ... bottom out on the stem rails' (cited to https://www.hlplanet.com/gateron-magnetic-switches/)

apps/web/src/content/articles/gateron-magnetic-jade-deep-dive.mdx:'What the magnet does in this particular stem' — 'initial magnetic flux of 120±15Gs ... bottom-out flux of 800±80Gs at the end of 3.5±0.2mm of travel' (cited to https://wooting.io/product/gateron-magnetic-jade-switches)

apps/web/src/content/articles/gateron-magnetic-jade-deep-dive.mdx:'Where the Jade sits in Gateron's magnetic catalog' — 'initial force tightens from 30±7gf to 36±5gf, travel tolerance from ±0.2mm to ±0.1mm, rest flux from ±15Gs to ±8Gs, bottom-out flux from 800±80Gs to 700±30Gs ... side latches' (Jade Pro; cited to Gateron comparison post and hlplanet table)
